title: Top 10 EV-Friendly Hotels in Asia for Families
excerpt: The best family-friendly hotels in Asia with EV charging — from Bangkok to Bali, KL to Singapore. Detailed reviews with charger types, family amenities, and booking tips for an electric family getaway.
author: EV Charging Asia Team
content:
# Top 10 EV-Friendly Hotels in Asia for Families

Finding a hotel with reliable EV charging is one of the biggest concerns for families planning an electric road trip in Asia. Nothing kills a vacation vibe faster than arriving tired with hungry kids only to discover the hotel's single charger is broken or occupied.

We've done the research. These ten hotels across Southeast Asia offer reliable EV charging **plus** genuine family-friendly amenities — kids' clubs, pools, play areas, and family-sized rooms.

## How We Selected These Hotels

Every hotel on this list has been verified through:
- Recent traveler check-ins on PlugShare and our own platform
- Confirmed charger type and number of slots
- Family-friendly amenities (pool, kids' club, nearby activities)
- Proximity to public charging as a backup

We've excluded hotels where the only charger is a single AC 7kW unit that's perpetually occupied — that's not real EV-friendliness.

## 1. Banyan Tree Hua Hin, Thailand

**Location:** Hua Hin, 200 km south of Bangkok
**Charger:** 2x AC 22kW (Type 2) — complimentary for guests
**Best for:** Luxury family getaway

Banyan Tree Hua Hin sits on the beachfront with lagoon-access rooms that kids absolutely love — you step directly from your terrace into the pool. The two AC chargers are in secure covered parking, and the hotel will prioritize charging for you if you request it at check-in.

**Family highlights:**
- Kids' club with daily activities (Thai cooking, batik painting)
- Two large pools (one dedicated kids' pool with shallow area)
- Beachfront with complimentary kayaks and paddleboards
- In-room dining with a dedicated kids' menu

**Nearby backup charging:** BluPort Hua Hin Mall (2 km) — EA Anywhere 120kW DC, 4 slots. The mall has a large indoor play area and cinema.

**Pro tip:** Request the EV parking spot closest to the charger port — only one of the two spots can reach without an extension cable. Bring your Type 2 cable even though the hotel says they have one.

**Price range:** THB 6,000-12,000/night (family lagoon access room)

👉 **Book your stay:** [Banyan Tree Hua Hin on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Hua+Hin&nflt=ht_id%3D204&sb=1)

---

## 2. Rosewood Phuket, Thailand

**Location:** Tri Trang Beach, Phuket
**Charger:** 2x AC 22kW (Type 2) — complimentary
**Best for:** Multi-generational family trips

The Rosewood Phuket is arguably the most EV-friendly luxury resort in Southeast Asia. The management has invested in proper EV infrastructure — the chargers are well-maintained and monitored, and the valet team will move cars to free up the charger if needed.

**Family highlights:**
- **Kids' Club (The Explorers)** — 200 sqm indoor/outdoor space with cooking classes, Thai language lessons, and nature walks
- Family pool with slide (not just a plunge pool — an actual water slide)
- Babysitting service available (THB 500/hour, book 24 hours ahead)
- Complimentary buggy service across the sprawling property

**Nearby backup charging:** Central Festival Phuket (8 km) — EA Anywhere 100kW DC, 6 slots. Also has movie theater, food court, and indoor play zones.

**Pro tip:** The hotel's chargers are in the underground car park. If you're driving a larger EV (Model Y, Ioniq 5), the ramp down is tight — valet can park for you.

**Price range:** THB 12,000-25,000/night

---

## 3. Shangri-La Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

**Location:** KL City Centre, near KL Tower
**Charger:** 2x AC 22kW (Type 2) — RM 50/night flat fee
**Best for:** Urban family exploration

The Shangri-La KL occupies an unbeatable location — walking distance to KL Tower, Bukit Bintang shopping, and the KLCC park. The hotel's EV chargers are in the secure basement parking with 24-hour security.

**Family highlights:**
- **Kids' club** with Xbox, art corner, and supervised activities
- Large free-form pool (30m, has a kid-friendly shallow section)
- In-room kids' amenities (tent, toys, kid-sized bathrobe — request at booking)
- **Lemon Garden** restaurant has a dedicated kids' buffet corner

**Nearby backup charging:** Suria KLCC (800m walk) — ChargEV AC 22kW + DC 50kW, 4 slots. The mall has Petrosains Discovery Centre and Aquaria KLCC.

**Pro tip:** Join the Golden Circle loyalty program (free) for priority charging booking. The hotel can also arrange an EV-specific parking spot if you email them 48 hours before arrival.

**Price range:** RM 400-800/night

---

## 4. Sunway Resort Hotel, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

**Location:** Sunway City, KL
**Charger:** DC 50kW + 4x AC 22kW — complimentary for guests
**Best for:** Families who want everything on-site

Sunway Resort sits right next to **Sunway Lagoon** — one of Asia's best water parks. The hotel has the most comprehensive EV charging setup of any Southeast Asian resort, with dedicated EV parking bays monitored by CCTV.

**Family highlights:**
- Direct access to Sunway Lagoon (6 theme parks, including Nickelodeon-themed Lost Lagoon)
- Ice-skating rink
- Indoor trampoline park
- Mini zoo (parrots, tortoises, rabbits — kids can feed them)
- Multiple pools (one with a 25m slide)

**Nearby backup charging:** Sunway Pyramid Mall (connected walkway) — ChargEV DC 50kW + AC 22kW, 6 slots. The mall has 1,000+ retail outlets, so charge while you shop.

**Pro tip:** Book the **Lagoon View Family Suite** — it has a separate kid's room with bunk beds. The DC fast charger is in high demand; use the AC chargers overnight instead.

**Price range:** RM 500-1,200/night (check for stay-and-play packages)

---

## 5. Hard Rock Hotel Penang, Malaysia

**Location:** Batu Ferringhi Beach, Penang
**Charger:** 4x AC 22kW (Type 2) — complimentary
**Best for:** Families with older kids and teens

The Hard Rock Hotel Penang is the safest bet for EV-charging hotel stays in Malaysia. With **four AC chargers** (more than most resorts), you'll almost never find all occupied. The chargers are in the covered basement parking near the lifts.

**Family highlights:**
- **Roxity Kids' Club** — daily supervised activities (4-12 years), complimentary
- **Teen Spirit Club** — pool table, PlayStation 5, karaoke (for ages 12+)
- Three pools including the largest free-form pool on Batu Ferringhi
- **Rock Spa** offers family packages (parent massage + kids' facial = yes, real)

**Nearby backup charging:** Gurney Paragon Mall (15 min drive) — DC 50kW, 4 slots. Also Queensbay Mall (20 min) — DC 180kW, 4 slots.

**Pro tip:** Book the **Platinum Suite** on Level 8 — it's the only floor with direct lift access to the car park (other floors require a lift transfer). The chargers are on Level P1, Row C — nearest to the lift lobby.

**Price range:** RM 350-700/night

---

## 6. InterContinental Chumphon, Thailand

**Location:** Chumphon, Southern Thailand
**Charger:** 2x AC 22kW — complimentary for guests
**Best for:** Stopover on Bangkok-Phuket road trip

This seaside resort is strategically located at the midpoint of the Bangkok-Phuket road trip (about 460 km from each). The hotel installed EV charging specifically to cater to the growing number of electric road-trippers. It's not the most luxurious option on this list, but it's perfectly positioned for EV travelers.

**Family highlights:**
- Beachfront infinity pool (kids' area, 1.2m depth)
- Dolphin-watching tours depart from the hotel's private pier
- Kids' menu at all three restaurants
- Board games and coloring packs in the lobby library

**Nearby backup charging:** Ocean Shopping Mall Chumphon (3 km) — EA Anywhere 120kW DC, 4 slots. Open 10 AM - 9 PM.

**Pro tip:** This is primarily an overnight stopover. Arrive by 4 PM so the kids can enjoy the pool before sunset. The dolphin tour is at 7 AM — skip it unless your kids are early risers.

**Price range:** THB 3,000-6,000/night

---

## 7. Holiday Inn Resort Singapore (Atrium)

**Location:** Singapore River Valley
**Charger:** 2x AC 7kW (Type 2) — complimentary, first-come-first-served
**Best for:** Singapore city break before crossing to Malaysia

Singapore has hundreds of public chargers, but hotels with dedicated EV parking are still limited. The Holiday Inn Atrium offers two complimentary AC chargers in a covered parking lot, and its location is ideal — 10 minutes to Tuas Checkpoint for your Malaysia road trip.

**Family highlights:**
- Outdoor pool with waterslide (small but exciting for young kids)
- Kids' stay-and-eat-free policy
- Walking distance to **River Safari** (giant pandas!) and **Gardens by the Bay**
- Family rooms with bunk beds

**Backup charging:** SP Group chargers at **Great World City Mall** (5 min walk) — DC 50kW, 8 slots.

**Pro tip:** The two chargers here get claimed fast. Email the hotel 24 hours before check-in to request one. If none available, the Great World City backup chargers are excellent.

**Price range:** SGD 200-350/night

---

## 8. MAYA Hotel & Resort, Chiang Mai, Thailand

**Location:** Nimmanhaemin Area, Chiang Mai
**Charger:** 1x DC 50kW + 2x AC 22kW — free for guests
**Best for:** Families exploring Northern Thailand

MAYA Lifestyle Mall (connected to the hotel) has one of Chiang Mai's most reliable EV charging stations. While the hotel itself doesn't manage the chargers, the mall's units are in the same parking structure and are well-maintained.

**Family highlights:**
- Rooftop pool with mountain views (shallow kids' section)
- Walking distance to Nimman's kid-friendly cafes and playgrounds
- MAYA Mall has a cinema, food court, and weekend craft market
- **Chiang Mai Zoo** and **Doi Suthep** are 15-20 min drive

**Nearby backup charging:** Central Festival Chiang Mai (3 km) — EA Anywhere 100kW DC, 6 slots. This is the most reliable backup in Chiang Mai.

**Pro tip:** The DC charger is in the MAYA Mall car park (Level B2). The mall opens at 11 AM — if you need to charge earlier, use the hotel's AC chargers on Level B1. Check our [Thailand EV Charging Guide](/blog/thailand-ev-charging-guide-bangkok-chiang-mai-phuket-pattaya) for more Chiang Mai charging information.

**Price range:** THB 2,500-5,000/night

---

## 9. Hyatt Regency Sanur, Bali

**Location:** Sanur Beach, Bali
**Charger:** 2x AC 22kW (Type 2) — complimentary for guests
**Best for:** Families exploring Bali by EV

Sanur is the best base for EV exploration in Bali — it's centrally located on the east coast, equidistant from Canggu (40 min), Ubud (1 hour), and Nusa Dua (20 min). The Hyatt Regency's chargers are well-maintained and monitored by security.

**Family highlights:**
- Large lagoon pool with slide — one of the best hotel pools in Bali for kids
- **Camp Hyatt** kids' club (supervised, 4-12 years, free)
- Beachfront with calm waters (Sanur's reef protects the beach — no strong currents)
- Bicycle rental for family cycling along the Sanur beach boardwalk

**Nearby backup charging:** **Bali's EA Anywhere chargers** are at **Beachwalk Mall** (Kuta, 20 min drive) — AC 22kW, and **Ubud City Centre** (1 hour north) — AC 22kW. Bali's charging infrastructure is still developing, so plan accordingly.

**Pro tip:** Drive to the **Bali Safari & Marine Park** (40 min from Sanur) — it's one of Bali's best family attractions, and they have a designated EV parking area with a dedicated charger (call ahead to confirm availability).

**Price range:** IDR 1,500,000-3,000,000/night

See the full [Bali EV Road Trip Loop](/routes/bali-ev-road-trip-loop)

---

## 10. Hilton Garden Inn, Bangkok Riverside, Thailand

**Location:** Bangkok Riverside (Rama III)
**Charger:** 1x DC 50kW + 2x AC 22kW — complimentary
**Best for:** Bangkok city exploration before or after road trips

This mid-range option punches above its weight for EV travelers. The DC 50kW charger is a rarity in Bangkok hotels — most only have AC 7kW. The location on Rama III Road gives quick access to both the southern highway (to Phuket) and the northern highway (to Chiang Mai).

**Family highlights:**
- Rooftop infinity pool with river views
- Shuttle boat to **ICONSIAM** (one of Bangkok's best family malls, with indoor waterfall and floating market)
- Riverside walking path
- 24-hour convenience store in the lobby

**Nearby backup charging:** **ICONSIAM** (1 km via shuttle) — EA Anywhere DC 120kW, 8 slots. The mall has an incredible indoor play zone, cinema, and food court.

**Pro tip:** The DC charger is in the open-air car park (Level P1). It shares the spot with a regular parking bay — if an ICE car parks there, ask the front desk to arrange a tow or use the AC chargers instead.

**Price range:** THB 2,000-4,000/night

---

## Honorable Mentions

These hotels have EV charging but didn't make the top 10 due to limited charger availability:
- **JW Marriott Phuket** — 1x AC 22kW (often occupied, better to use Central Festival)
- **Pullman KLCC** — DC 50kW (excellent charger, limited family amenities)
- **Capella Singapore** — 1x AC 22kW (luxurious but only one charger)
- **Sala Ayutthaya** — 1x AC 7kW (beautiful hotel, very slow charging)
- **Anantara Chiang Mai** — EU 2x AC 22kW (good, but remote from public backup)

## How to Book an EV-Friendly Hotel: Checklist

Before booking any hotel claiming to have EV charging:

1. **Confirm the charger type** — Is it Type 2 AC or CCS2 DC? Do you need your own cable?
2. **Confirm how many chargers** — A hotel with 1 charger for 200 rooms is not EV-friendly
3. **Ask about reservation** — Can you book a charging slot or is it first-come-first-served?
4. **Check recent reviews** — Search PlugShare for that hotel's charger status in the last 2 weeks
5. **Identify backups** — What nearby public chargers can you use if the hotel's are occupied?
6. **Bring your cable** — Even if they say they provide one, many hotels' cables go missing

## The Bottom Line

The hotel EV charging landscape in Southeast Asia is improving rapidly. In 2024, we had maybe five hotels worth recommending. In 2026, we have dozens. The trend is clear: hotels that invest in proper charging infrastructure (multiple units, DC options, managed queues) are winning the EV family traveler market.

If you're planning a family EV road trip, book at least one of these hotels to guarantee a smooth charging experience. Use our [station search](/search) to find public chargers near any hotel as a backup, and always check recent check-ins before departing.

faq.question: Do hotels charge extra?
faq.answer: Most mid-range+ hotels include EV charging free. Budget hotels may charge RM 15-30 per session. Always ask.

faq.question: Which charging type?
faq.answer: Type 2 AC (7kW-22kW) is most common. 7kW adds roughly 40 km/hour. DC fast chargers at hotels are rare.

faq.question: How to confirm availability?
faq.answer: Call the hotel directly. Never rely on booking.com filters alone. Ask about Type 2 vs CCS2 and adapters.

faq.question: Best hotel chain for EV drivers?
faq.answer: Accor (Pullman, Novotel) and Marriott (Sheraton, JW Marriott) have the most consistent charging across Asia.
